revisions.evidence: fixed_context: EFF_TECH_OVERLOAD.activate (timed_effects/physical.lua) sets max_steam to getMaxSteam() (doubles capacity) and steam_regen to -self.steam_regen/2 (halves regen). T_TECH_OVERLOAD info (talents/steam/automated-butchery.lua) says steam regeneration is halved.

fixed_context: EFF_DEATH_FROM_ABOVE: activate grants evasion, projectile_evasion, movement_speed, levitation, avoid_pressure_traps, and learns Rocket Barrage; no on_timeout auto-fire. Rocket Barrage in tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/artillery.lua fires only when used; target: 每回合自动使用火箭弹幕再次发射
revisions.observation: 触发机制错误，死亡天降效果并不会每回合自动发射火箭弹幕（无 on_timeout 自动发射机制），而是主动使用火箭弹幕技能时发射。

revisions.evidence: source: +%d%% to all damage dealt; target: -%d%% 所有造成的伤害; fixed_context: CHAOS_ORBS is beneficial and applies inc_damage={all=eff.stacks*3}.
revisions.observation: 数值符号与机制方向错误，混沌之球为增益效果增加伤害，译文误写为降低伤害（-%d%%）。

revisions.evidence: source: increase all detrimental effects durations by 6 turns on application; target: 将所有负面效果持续时间延长3回合
revisions.observation: 数值错误，负面效果延长持续时间原文为 6 回合，译文错误写为 3 回合。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: The shortening occurs when Suspend deactivates; target: 每回合，非“其他”类且不会在无时间状态下自行衰减的负面效果，以及技能冷却时间会缩短
revisions.observation: 触发时机错误，负面效果与技能冷却时间的缩短是在时间暂留效果解除（deactivate）时一次性结算扣除，而非每回合缩短。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: 'explode' is spreading a weaker fire DoT, not an instant burst hit.

fixed_context: EFF_WRITHING_HAIRS.callbackOnTakeDamage in tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua returns {dam = dam * eff.brittle / 100} on a 35%% proc, which replaces the incoming hit's damage with dam*brittle/100... it is a damage-reduction proc

fixed_context: EFF_FIRE_SHIELD.deactivate ... runs on ANY effect termination ... and executes self:project(..., DamageType.FIREBURN, {dur=3, dam=self:spellCrit(eff.power)}) in radius eff.radius -- a 3-turn burn DoT, not a single instant hit.
source: any new debuff on you lasts %d%% longer; target: 持续时间缩短 %d%%; fixed_context: callbackOnTemporaryEffect only extends a newly applied effect
revisions.observation: 机制方向错误，新施加的负面效果持续时间应为延长（lasts %d%% longer），译文误写为“缩短”。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: HYPOSTASIS_AWAKEN.activate removes detrimental effects except type other and clears talents_cd when applied. on_timeout then creates a radius-2 random explosion each turn with darkness and temporal damage and digs diggable walls.

fixed_context: EFF_CORROSIVE_FLECHETTE.callbackOnMeleeHit/callbackOnArcheryHit (timed_effects/physical.lua) burst one flechette and skip if src==self, src dead, self:reactionToward(src)>=0, or src is not an actor; target: 任意单位的近战或远程攻击命中目标时
revisions.observation: 触发主体条件错误，自身攻击、友方单位攻击（reactionToward>=0）及非角色均不触发毒镖爆裂，译文加入“任意单位”与实际代码判定冲突。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: a hit on a different actor removes the effect; target: 命中其他敌人则效果不会结束
revisions.observation: 机制相反，近战命中其他敌人会移除该效果，译文误写为“命中其他敌人则效果不会结束”。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: EFF_PAIN_ENHANCEMENT_SYSTEM.activate (tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua) sets inc_stats only for STAT_DEX/MAG/WIL/CUN/CON; STAT_STR is absent; target: 包括力量在内的所有属性增加 %d
revisions.observation: 作用属性范围错误，痛苦强化系统增加除力量以外的所有属性（STAT_STR 不增加），译文误写为“包括力量在内”。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: SPIKESKIN applies resists={all=eff.power}; terminology/combat.tsv maps resists.all / All Resists to 全部抗性.
source: Storing damage to unleash as a powerful lightning bolt; target: 已格挡伤害无法累积; fixed_context: on_merge adds successive power and caps at max_power.
revisions.observation: 机制相反，电力放出效果会累积格挡伤害，译文误写为“已格挡伤害无法累积”。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: EFF_FIERY_SALVE activate adds damage_affinity for FIRE, LIGHT, LIGHTNING. English long_desc still says frost aura (copy-paste). Item apply ... grants a fiery aura
fixed_context: turret bearers still retaliate with the original caster's shield, once per attacker per turn. resists.all terminology is All Resists=全部抗性.
fixed_context: EFF_STEAM_SHIELD.activate registers on_melee_hit fire damage of eff.retaliate; ranged hits do not trigger.

fixed_context: LIGHTNING_DAZE applies EFF_DAZED for (dam.daze_duration or 3). Talent apply tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/gadgets.lua AED info already says 3 turns. The English status key still says 2 turns; Chinese follows the effect code, not the English key wording; target: 同时使目标眩晕 2 回合
revisions.observation: 持续时间错误，实际造成的眩晕持续时间为 3 回合（LIGHTNING_DAZE 默认持续时间为 3 回合），译文仍错误保留英文词条中的 2 回合。

revisions.evidence: fixed_context: EFF_UNRAVEL_EXISTENCE callback acts only when e.type is magical and e.status is detrimental
fixed_context: callbackOnMeleeHit(self, eff, src, dam) returns unless dam>0 and src==eff.src, then src:heal(eff.heal)
fixed_context: EFF_MIASMA.callbackOnHit (timed_effects/physical.lua) returns unless src.turn_procs.weapon_type and not self.turn_procs.miasma, then sets self.turn_procs.miasma and projects acid.
fixed_context: EFF_REACTIVE_ARMOR.callbackOnHit (timed_effects/physical.lua) returns if self.turn_procs.reactive_armor is set, then sets it on trigger (once per turn)
fixed_context: Pet on_act (talents/steam/mecharachnid.lua) applies EFF_MECHARACHNID_OFS for 4 turns when player-controlled mecharachnid loses LOS to summoner; target: 若未能在一回合内恢复视线
revisions.observation: 持续时间/宽限时间机制错误，脱离视野效果持续 4 回合（eff.dur 倒计时至 <=1 时失去控制），并非在 1 回合内失去直接控制。
